# SillyMaker

SillyMaker is a React and TypeScript engine for GUI applications and games. It
keeps ordinary React, CSS, browser semantics, and frontend packages available,
then lets a product add deterministic State, Scene, Save/replay, scalable
content, input, and authoring capabilities deliberately.

## Choose a path

- GUI application: ./guides/gui-application/
- Game: ./guides/game-application/
- Core concepts: ./concepts/

## Start a project

- Agent-first guide: ./start/
- Manual setup: ./start/manual/
- Project structure: ./start/project-structure/

Quick repository workflow:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/jasl/silly-maker
cd silly-maker
deno install
deno task app dev template
```
